dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped light-gray ring structures with irregular, soft-edged perimeters that transition from dark charcoal-gray exteriors to lighter interior centers, forming a reticulated network on the dorsal-lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, dark, solid-toned pixel clusters distributed between the macro-annuli, particularly concentrated along the dorsal ridge and lack any internal tonal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an obtuse scalene triangle. Smaller high-intensity blobs are arranged in a non-linear, stochastic distribution across the central dorsal region.
